name: preference-picker
description: A titled exclusive list. The current value is the checked row. Drop it in a sheet or a screen.
avoidWhen: Do not use for independent toggles; use setting-row. Do not embed a dropdown.

ux.behaviour: The title names the preference; the checked row is the current value
ux.why: You should see what is on before you change it

ux.behaviour: Picking a row ticks and calls onSelect; the caller dismisses the host
ux.why: The picker chooses; the sheet leaves

aiHints: Host this in a bottom sheet or a detail pane; it does not present itself
Do not dismiss inside onSelect unless you own the host
